svg.title: A judge is a classifier. Measure it first.
svg.desc: A hand-drawn diagram in which fifty outputs are scored independently by a human, the only ground truth, and by a rubric-driven judge, and both feed a two-by-two confusion matrix reading 28, 4, 3 and 15 that yields Cohen's kappa of 0.71 with po 0.86 and pe 0.52 written out. A thermometer beside it marks 0.0 coin flip through 0.6 SUBSTANTIAL, drawn as the green ship line, to 0.8 almost perfect. An arrow going straight from the judge to a CI gate, bypassing the matrix, is crossed out as the mistake everyone makes. Two insets show position bias - 61.5 percent picked whichever came first - and verbosity bias, the same content scoring 3.4 short and 4.0 padded, and three bars track kappa from 0.11 with no rubric to 0.71 with binary criteria and anchors.
svg.text: A judge is a classifier. Measure it first.
ground truth - the only one there is
straight to CI without the matrix:
this is the mistake everyone makes
the reasoning it writes is not
